archive: archive/ holds past editions: read only, never run; to rerun one, use the old release install.
step: step 8 NOVELTY of ALARM_PIPELINE_V1 section 1: before an idea is called new
question: Is this fire list a new alarm, a copy of one in the registry, its mirror, or a known trigger given a side?

commands.name: check
commands.does: compares one fire list with every registry alarm that has a fire list on dev and prints the 3 nearest and a VERDICT

args.name: --settings
args.meaning: this machine's settings file (KEY=VALUE lines read by _tools/settings_v1.py); always named on the command line

args.name: FIRE_LIST.tsv
args.meaning: a tab file with coin, t (whole epoch seconds) and side when the alarm has one; relative paths are under RESEARCH_ROOT/ALARM_DESIGN

args.name: --lean
args.meaning: FADE or FOLLOW: the trading side (without it the side cannot be told and same fires stand in for same side)

args.name: --self
args.meaning: <SEAT>_<IDEA>: leave out that idea's own rows

refuses.when: REFUSED: <reason> on stderr: no --settings or twice, a settings file refused, RESEARCH_ROOT empty, a lean other than FADE or FOLLOW, a file without coin and t columns or without fire rows, a t or side that is not a whole number, a registry without its columns

rules: NEW means every overlap under 40 pct (the owner 30 Oct 2026 06:20 Berlin)
dry_run_data: planted by _tools/tests/test_agent_docs_v1.py in a new temp folder: {SETTINGS} its settings file, {WORLD} the folder, {ALARM} this Alarm folder; run AD1_20261029, idea FLOWX
